notes.title: Introducing the SILENT TUNDRA!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]The [b]SILENT TUNDRA[/b] is the first major update to Honest Helper! It includes 10+ new hand-made levels with entirely new art. Play as penguins, a bunny, and a stoat in order to fight back against the big and terrifying Cengul species. There is also new dialogue cutscenes that expand the overall story of Honest Helper! I hope you enjoy this new major update and I look forward to hearing your feedback![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614909/69f2a2cab542a4d20b8992542e269a221a433102.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]a small penguin holding a sack of fruit... focused on the art of "foraging"[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614909/8dc7044a887e7228bdd5f8fd5886bab5342002bc.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]the invasive Cengul species[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614909/9b691264a350c617bf8a85f663723cf6320bfe89.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]a slightly taller penguin... quite skilled with the axe[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614909/b6abd97535173be19424468dad8a6f049800b162.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]a cute but dangerous bunny[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]HAVE FUN![/b][/p]

- fixed crash error when skipping cutscenes
- opens the Handbook automatically on 2A

(changes also made to demo)
